note: sigma_h/credulous is the plurality projection over all legal labellings (the in-corpus reading behind committed-only accuracy in the paper); on these frameworks sigma_H admits 10-550 labellings, so the plurality commits almost everywhere -- reported for honesty, not as a meaningful point predictor. Status 'none' = the predictor has no labelling/extension on that framework (excluded from every score, counted in n_no_prediction).
